svg.title: A stand at the fair, at night
svg.desc: Pixel art of a trade-fair hall at night with an open stand: a rigging truss with spotlights and a hanging banner reading Brand space, an LED wall where pixel type flows (Communication in space), a white reception counter with a host, a tall plant, a lit product plinth, two lounge chairs with a small table, and carpet on a raised floor. Tiny visitors walk along the aisle, and Pix walks among them.
